entries.name: Stone
entries.description: Struck from the seams beneath the academy. Stone holds a shape until something breaks it, which is why its students are the ones who finish long duels.

entries.name: Bloom
entries.description: Grown rather than made. Bloom rarely wins a turn and rarely loses a match, and the terraces are full of students who learned that the hard way.

entries.name: Flame
entries.description: Cut from wood that never cooled. Flame spends what it has early and asks the duel to end before the accounting.

entries.name: Aether
entries.description: The only school with no seam and no grove. Aether is written rather than gathered, and its students are the ones who decide what a duel is about.
